revision_reason: Development-only results made explicit that exact ordered-subsequence recovery is invariant to these deletions by construction. Version 2 freezes that interpretation, clarifies descriptive contrasts, and removes ambiguous metric labels before held-out evaluation.
purpose: Test exact-method invariants, heuristic robustness, and source-location ambiguity as retained lexical evidence becomes sparser under controlled interior target deletions.
interpretation: Deleting target chunks while leaving the source unchanged guarantees that every retained canonical chunk remains in source order. taln and full-coverage LCS recovery are therefore construction invariants and method-agreement checks, not empirical superiority or degradation outcomes. difflib behavior and punctuation-tokenized taln candidate ambiguity are descriptive empirical outcomes. This is not a generative model of LLM errors and does not evaluate semantic correctness.

variant_design.canonical_chunks: Maximal non-whitespace target chunks matched by regex \S+ before applying any evaluated tokenizer.
variant_design.factorial: Generate one deterministic variant for every gap-count by gap-width combination.
variant_design.common_cohort_eligibility: Require at least 13 canonical chunks, equal to max_gap_count * max_gap_width + max_gap_count + 1. Every included record therefore contributes every condition.
variant_design.placement_rule: Distribute retained chunks as evenly as possible across the gap_count + 1 retained segments, assigning any remainder from left to right, then alternate retained segments with fixed-width deleted blocks.
variant_design.stage1_compatibility: For one gap of width one, the rule deletes chunk floor(n / 2), matching the Stage 1 central deletion.
variant_design.target_construction: Delete the selected chunks and join retained chunks with one ASCII space.
variant_design.contiguous_control: Preserve the undeleted target as gap_count=0 and gap_width=0 for a self-contained baseline.
variant_design.still_contiguous_policy: If a shortened target remains an exact normalized substring anywhere in the source, label it still_contiguous_control and exclude it from primary non-contiguous summaries.
variant_design.gold_localization: Use the outer original-text interval of every literal occurrence of the undeleted target in the source. Shortened-target occurrences elsewhere are not gold.
variant_design.placement_limit: Each record contributes one balanced placement per condition. Candidate-burden differences are descriptive for these frozen placements and are not interpreted as causal effects of gap topology.

matrix.exact_substring: Evaluate normalized character substring matching once per variant as a construction control.

metrics.candidate_burden_population: Report candidate burden only for punctuation-tokenized taln tasks with full lexical support. Capped counts are lower bounds. cl100k_base evaluates two contextual target variants, so its raw path counts are not compared with single-variant tokenizers.
metrics.no_matched_token_path_definition: candidate_count equals zero. This is not the complement of full reconstruction because partial matched-token paths can exist when some target tokens are absent.
metrics.localization_note: Label taln localization as any-candidate gold-interval coverage. Label exact, LCS, and difflib localization as selected-path gold-interval hit. These are different capabilities and are not ranked as interchangeable accuracy measures.
metrics.runtime_note: Per-task runtime is diagnostic because tokenizer caching and serial method order affect it. Separate repeated benchmarks are required for runtime claims.

severity_contrasts.name: three-vs-one-gap-at-width-one
severity_contrasts.interpretation: Descriptive change with more separated deletion events and two additional deleted chunks.

severity_contrasts.name: width-three-vs-width-one-at-one-gap
severity_contrasts.interpretation: Descriptive change with a wider deletion and two additional deleted chunks.

severity_contrasts.name: three-separated-vs-one-wide-three-chunks
severity_contrasts.interpretation: Both variants delete three chunks; placements and deleted token identities differ, so this is a descriptive fragmentation comparison rather than a causal estimate.

severity_contrasts.name: two-separated-vs-one-wide-two-chunks
severity_contrasts.interpretation: Both variants delete two chunks; placements and deleted token identities differ, so this is a descriptive fragmentation comparison rather than a causal estimate.

heldout_policy: Generate and hash the complete variant manifest before evaluation. Validate the development pipeline first, then run the held-out matrix once with the frozen manifest, matrix, candidate cap, reporting rules, canonical input paths, and canonical output path. Record started and completed states in an immutable canonical ledger. Held-out overwrite and parameter overrides are forbidden.
